word-keyboard.def: the set of keys you press to type letters and numbers

word-computer-mouse.def: a small device you move by hand to control the pointer on a screen

word-storage.def: space on a device where files are kept

word-usb-stick.def: a small portable device you plug in to carry files from one place to another

word-cloud-storage.def: an online service that keeps your files on distant machines so you can open them anywhere

word-software.def: the programs and instructions that tell a computer what to do

word-hardware.def: the physical parts of a machine, such as the screen and the disk

word-computer-program.def: a list of instructions that a machine follows to do a job

word-code.def: the written instructions that make a program work

word-programming.def: the work of writing instructions for computers

word-algorithm.def: a list of clear steps for solving a problem or doing a task

word-database.def: a large set of organized information stored so a computer can find it quickly

word-browser.def: a program you use to look at pages on the internet

word-search-engine.def: a website that finds pages on the internet that match the words you type

word-search-online.def: to look for information on the internet

word-click.def: to press a button on a mouse to choose something on a screen

word-scroll.def: to move what is on a screen up or down to see more

word-tap-screen.def: to touch a screen lightly with a finger to choose something

word-swipe.def: to slide a finger across a screen to move or change what is shown

word-paste.def: to put copied words or pictures into a new place

word-undo.def: to cancel the last change you made on a computer

word-folder.def: a place on a computer where you keep a group of files

word-screenshot.def: a picture of what is showing on a screen

word-update.def: to install a newer version of a program or system

word-uninstall.def: to remove a program completely from a device

word-error.def: a mistake, or a message telling you that something went wrong

word-hacker.def: a person who gets into computer systems without permission

word-backup.def: an extra copy of your files kept in case the original is lost

word-artificial-intelligence.def: computer systems that can do things that normally need human thinking

word-smartphone.def: a mobile phone that can run apps and connect to the internet

word-scanner.def: a machine that copies a page or picture into a file

word-webcam.def: a small camera on a computer used for video calls

word-bluetooth.def: a wireless technology that connects devices over short distances

word-electronic.def: working with tiny circuits, as in phones and computers

word-streaming.def: playing video or music over the internet without saving it first

word-podcast.def: a series of audio shows you can download or listen to online

word-emoji.def: a small picture used in text messages to show a feeling or idea

word-selfie.def: a photo you take of yourself, usually with a phone

word-follower.def: a person who chooses to see everything another person shares online

word-comment.def: a short written reaction that someone leaves under a post or video

word-post-online.def: to put a message, photo or video on a website for others to see

word-subscribe.def: to sign up to receive new videos, emails or updates from someone

word-privacy.def: the right to keep your personal details secret from others

word-user.def: a person who operates a computer system, app or website
